typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		EXTNL_TRD_SRCE_CD as string,
		CXL_OFFST_CD as string,
		VRFR_USR_ID as string,
		EXTNL_TRD_ID as string,
		CUST_ACCT_NBR as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(Create_dt = currentTimestamp()) ~> GetCurrentdate1
GetCurrentdate1 derive({Copy of EXTNL_TRD_SRCE_CD} = EXTNL_TRD_SRCE_CD,
		{Copy of EXTNL_TRD_ID} = EXTNL_TRD_ID,
		{Copy of CXL_OFFST_CD} = CXL_OFFST_CD,
		{Copy of CUST_ACCT_NBR} = CUST_ACCT_NBR,
		{Copy of VRFR_USR_ID} = VRFR_USR_ID) ~> DataConversion
GetCurrentdate1 aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DataConversion sink(input(
		cust_acct_nbr as string,
		vrfr_usr_id as string,
		cxl_offst_cd as string,
		extnl_trd_id as string,
		extnl_trd_srce_cd as string,
		Create_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,batchSize: 1000000,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		cust_acct_nbr = {Copy of CUST_ACCT_NBR},
		vrfr_usr_id = {Copy of VRFR_USR_ID},
		cxl_offst_cd = {Copy of CXL_OFFST_CD},
		extnl_trd_id = {Copy of EXTNL_TRD_ID},
		extnl_trd_srce_cd = {Copy of EXTNL_TRD_SRCE_CD},
		Create_DT = Create_dt),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
